backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing contact inquiries, site content, and website ratings with admin‑gated read/update actions and public submission endpoints.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a modal‑opening hero stats feature to its source file, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing their purpose, behavior, and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme definitions using OKLCH color tokens with dark‑mode defaults and global style resets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point enabling dark mode, metadata, favicon links, and injecting the React app root and main bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with hash‑based routing for home, admin, and team views and composition of all homepage sections.
frontend/src/components/admin/SiteConten: Admin form allowing editing of hero, services, about, and contact marketing content with React Query integration.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Unauthorized‑access screen showing login prompt or denial message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button handling auth state, error recovery, and React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders an About section with a background image, descriptive text, and a grid of service features using icons and cards.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Implements a contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and contact details, handling success and error states.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays a hero banner with video or fallback image, headings, action buttons, and modal-trigger elements.
frontend/src/components/sections/Ratings: Provides a rating form, displays average ratings and recent reviews, and submits new ratings with validation.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a list of service cards with images, descriptions, icons, and a button to scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/site/CookieConse: Displays a dismissible cookie consent banner using localStorage to remember acceptance or decline.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: Footer component with logo lightbox trigger, social links, navigation buttons, and smooth-scroll handlers.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx: Header with logo lightbox, nav menu, mobile sheet menu, and scroll/navigation logic.
frontend/src/components/site/LogoLightbo: Modal lightbox showing an enlarged logo with escape and click-to-close handling.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports static contact email and phone configuration values.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactInquiry.ts: Empty file placeholder for contact inquiry hook logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useInquiries.ts: Empty file placeholder for inquiries-related hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login, stored identities, and state transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for inquiries and ratings plus message‑parsing helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useSiteContent.ts: Hooks for fetching and updating site content with defaults and backend integration.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers, color variables, dark mode values, and custom animation utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard with authentication, admin checks, inquiry filtering, and site content editing.
frontend/src/pages/TeamPage.tsx: Renders the Team page featuring founder SWAROOP N with a profile card and image.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, color tokens, animations, typography, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, branding decisions, known issues, and feature tracking for the ALGLOBE TECHNO SOLUTIONS site.
